tools.name: ask_assistant
tools.description: Send a message to "Tridan-AI Welcome Assistant", the AI assistant behind "Home Welcome AI Agent TRIDAN", and get its full answer (it has its own instructions, knowledge base and tools). Returns a conversation_id — pass it back to continue the same conversation.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "e33ca24e3f53a6c6efe0925dcbb387600020c5a284bf2d9fcc49b86071f3bbc3" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: query_knowledge_base, ask_assistant · Public sink: ask_assistant.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: query_knowledge_base, ask_assistant · Public sink: ask_assistant

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
